description: A shell library for testing credential helpers, including functions for checking, rejecting, and testing credential helpers with various scenarios such as storing, retrieving, overwriting, and handling long headers, timeouts, and password expiry. Also includes a script for simulating an askpass program.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Function to test credential helpers with provided input and compare expected stdout and stderr.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from input until '--' is encountered, outputs each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Clears residual data from previous tests for a given helper.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects credentials for a given protocol, host, and username.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on a specified credential helper, including storing, retrieving, overwriting, and deleting credentials, as well as handling long headers.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing, retrieving, and overwriting password expiry times.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credential information, including capabilities and ephemeral data.
